index.description: Array of index names to migrate.

requests_per_second.description: The throttle for the migration task in sub-requests per second. Corresponds to requests_per_second on the Reindex API.

size.description: Number of alerts to migrate per batch. Corresponds to the source.size option on the Reindex API.

slices.description: The number of subtasks for the migration task. Corresponds to slices on the Reindex API.
